name: Wanderburg — Cinematic 3D
description: The full stack over the same meshes: perspective camera lower on the horizon, smooth (non-banded) shading, a real shadow map, denser fog. Heavier than the shipped look — the materials are authored for toon bands — so this variant is a mood experiment and a migration target rather than a release candidate. Every entity is SELF-PRESENTED (GAME_SPEC.entities declare representation "none"): js/WanderView.js + js/WanderMesh.js build the meshes on the kit engine layer, so the pipeline binds no second copy of anything.
